facts: Accredited Official Statistics

2005-2024 local/regional GHG scope
82.6 MB CSV available

sources.name: 2005 to 2024 UK local and regional greenhouse gas emissions technical report
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero / Ricardo
facts: Updated 30 June 2026
Spatial disaggregation of territorial CO2, CH4 and N2O on an end-user basis
Uses DESNZ sub-national gas and electricity statistics among main activity sources
Different sector methods are used according to available data quality
Local-authority estimates have explicit national, spatial-distribution and sector-share uncertainty components
LULUCF uncertainty is treated separately because it can dominate local uncertainty

sources.name: Sub-national road transport fuel consumption statistics: methodology summary, 2005-2024
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
facts: Updated 30 June 2026
Uses the 2024 NAEI/GHGI road-transport methodology
Combines DfT traffic census, vehicle licensing, MOT mileage, VKM and ANPR inputs
Uses COPERT 5.8 fuel-consumption-speed relationships
2024 EV VKM proportions are separated by vehicle and road type, with specific London treatment
The entire 2005-2023 time series is revised each year as methods and inputs improve
sources.role: Road methodology, revision and EV treatment gate
